verdict.rationale: The CRA is a national tax authority. Its core product is the sovereign function of registering, assessing and collecting tax, which by nature cannot be self-hosted, so self-hosting is a category error for this kind of product. Its sanctioned software channel (EFILE-certified third-party software transmitting to the CRA) is a client-to-agency filing path, not a self-hostable deployment of the agency's systems, so it does not make the axis applicable.
